paper_id: Probing the Geometry of Truth_ Consistency and Generalization of Truth Directions in LLMs Across Logical Transformations and Question Answering Tasks__oa_W4414893717
title: Probing the Geometry of Truth: Consistency and Generalization of Truth Directions in LLMs Across Logical Transformations and Question Answering Tasks
motivation: LLMs输出自信的虚假信息,可靠性存疑,需要理解其内部真值表示
problem_framing: 三个研究问题:真值方向是否普遍存在、简单探测是否足够、泛化能力
key_insight: 并非所有LLM都有consistent真值方向,强模型更一致,简单线性探测就足够
method_signature: 四类探测器的跨逻辑变换和QA泛化实验
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Truth是理想化概念,探测捕获的未必是真正的truth
evidence_for_taste: simple supervised probes are sufficiently expressive
differences in performance between probes become negligible
This finding indicates that probes may capture an overlap between widely accepted human beliefs
thinking_moves: 挑战先验假设:不是所有LLM都有真值方向
先验证随机模型无真值方向,再证真实模型有
反驳Levinstein结论:泛化失败源于LLM自身而非探测技术局限
弱分类器能区分表示则说明LLM隐式转换了输入
